♻ Crafting cycles you can run now

♻ Zero-loss cycle = the crafted item comes back in full every lap, so you only ever spend fuel/tools (e.g. charcoal). Cross-skill cycles grind two skills at once; same-skill ones just re-forge an item back and forth for XP in one skill. 📖 = the recipe must be learned from a magazine first.
